services.name: Christmas in July
services.desc: Join this special event on the M/S Mount Washington for a unique, fun-filled evening out on Lake Winnipesaukee. Tickets include a 3-hour cruise, buffet dinner, and entertainment with a cash bar. There will be also be great raffle items! All proceeds benefit the Greater Lakes Region Children’s Auction. Entertainment by DJ Nazzy, performance by Broadway North Dance Studio, complimentary wine tasting by Hermit Woods Winery, local beer tasting by Amoskeag Beverages, and live broadcasting from the Mount by Lakes 101.5 FM and 104.9 FM The Hawk. Santa and the Grinch will also be aboard the sunset A benefit for the Greater Lakes Region Children's Auction

services.name: Winnipesaukee Spirit Cocktail Cruises
services.desc: Explore Meredith Bay and the islands of Western Winnipesaukee on the newest addition to our fleet. During your relaxing 90 minute excursion on the Winnipesaukee Spirit, enjoy a leisurely tour while our skipper points out areas of interest along the way. While you enjoy the trip, nosh on freshly-made items from the galley. The Winnipesaukee Spirit also has a full bar, featuring signature cocktails, premium wines, and New Hampshire craft beers. Cruise Types The Winnipesaukee Spirit offers multiple daily departures in July and August, and special events in September and October. Island Cocktail Leisurely Tour with Drinks • 90 Minutes • Departures from Center Harbor and Wolfeboro

services.name: Narrated Scenic Tour from Weirs Beach
services.desc: Narrated Scenic Tours Experience the majesty of Lake Winnipesaukee during a narrated scenic tour aboard the historic M/S Mount Washington. Learn about the history of the region and local folklore, surrounded by some of the most beautiful scenery in New England. With daily departures from Weirs Beach, and convenient departures from Wolfeboro and Alton Bay on select days, it's easy to fit a cruise on "the Mount" into your travel plans. During your 2½ hour cruise, enjoy breakfast or lunch from our quick service restaurant, sample beer, wine and cocktails from our full bar, or browse a premium Narrated Cruise aboard historic M/S Mount Washington • 2.5 Hours • Book Now!

services.name: U.S. Mailboat Cruise
services.desc: s Launched on Lake Winnipesaukee in 1945, the M/V Sophie C continues a long tradition of delivering postal mail to the lake's summer island residents. On each two hour cruise, she'll visit a number of different islands, while her Skipper points out areas of interest along the way. On some islands Sophie's visit is the social event of the day, and island residents often come to the dock to say hello, and purchase an ice cream treat, snack or souvenir. Don't forget to send a postcard home! Passengers are invited to fill out and mail postcards right on board, complete Join the M/V Sophie C on her Mail Run! • 2 Hours

services.name: Haunted Winnipesaukee
services.desc: Lake Winnipesaukee is beautiful, but it has a dark side. During this 90 minute cruise, sample desserts while hearing haunting tales of cursed lands, mysterious fires, haunted hotels, and unsolved disappearances. Please note: this cruise involves the live reading of ghost stories by trained actors. We request that guests remain quiet during the performance of the stories, out of respect for the enjoyment of other guests. 90 minutes General Admission (Ages 5+) $59 Babies (Ages 4 and under) Free Please Note: Times listed are departure times. Plan to arrive at the port 30 minutes

quotes.text: We had an awesome time on the Mt Washington sunset dinner cruise! The cruise director was super helpful and checked in on everyone throughout the night! The food was great and drinks were delicious! There were two live music performances, one band on the lower deck and an acoustic guitarist on the higher deck, both were incredible! The views were stunning and we can't wait to come back!

We have been going on the Mount Washington for years now. What makes it even better is when you bring up guests for the weekend and you bring them out on this tour. Their excitement and enthusiasm is great to watch...Want to be a hero to your guests? Take them out on this and if you've never been yourself, you need to go. Any time of the year is great. Fall is my favorite.

We caught the cruise out of Wolfeboro - it was wonderful to experience Lake Winnipesaukee from the boat, which was beautiful and had 3 large levels. The staff were all super friendly. Boat and facilities were clean. Food from the galley was really good, too! Overall a great experience, would definitely do it again.

I have taken Mount Washington Cruises several times over the years. It is a wonderful way to spend a few hours with family, friends, and visitors from out of our area.... So go spend a few hours relaxing and taking in the beauty of Lake Winnipesaukee and New Hampshire.

We did the Sunday brunch cruise today. We took the cruise from Wolfeboro. The cruise was on time, very chill environment, the scenery were beautiful, and food was really good. I will go again and recommend people to take the whole family. Kids friendly as well.
